rationale: mṭaʕmatle is coordinated with eating u muklayḏe, under the same prohibition and with food as the anaphoric object. This supports tasting food, distinct from grafting trees. One clear attestation.

data.turoyo: Me d hule soz aʕmux, axul u muklayḏe, w d l obe soz aʕmux, lo kowe, d əxlat u muklayḏe, w lo kowe, d mṭaʕmatle.”
data.translation: Wenn er dir dann sein wart gegeben hat, so iß das Essen, das er dir vorsetzt; gibt er es nicht, so darfst du sein Essen nicht essen und nicht davon kosten.

rationale: First example of new II sense 2: coordinated eating/tasting of food makes the meaning and object reference explicit.

summary: II retains grafting sense 1 and gains tasting sense 2 without renumbering. The new sense is supported by Turoyo co-reference with u muklayḏe and coordination with əxlat, not merely by the German kosten.

The dependent Infectum mṭaʕmatle has a 2sg.m experiencer/actor and suffixed food stimulus -le. This is not a Preterit Intransitive example and provides no direct test of qaṭəl nominal-stimulus avoidance.
The existing Infectum grafting quotation and Infinitiv ṭeʕomo remain keyed to sense 1; neither is reinterpreted as tasting.
The entry's current etymological note concerns grafting only. No taste etymology or homonym split is asserted from this one passage.

Should tasting and grafting receive separate etymological/homonym treatment? Confirm a citation form and additional examples for tasting before assigning the existing Infinitiv or grafting forms to sense 2.
